summary: REQ-6 is partially addressed: /publish-help is not present in the shown TanStack Router route tree in App.tsx. However, PublishHelpPage still exists as a file (and is even listed as modified), and the diff does not provide clear evidence that the “Make This App Live” CTAs and their /publish-help navigation handlers were removed from LandingPage and UserProfile.

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove the dedicated publish help route and page so /publish-help is no longer part of the router route tree and PublishHelpPage is not shipped.
